name: AFA 2027 Annual Meeting
conf_dates_note: Welcome reception Saturday, January 2. Held alongside the ASSA Annual Meeting.
deadline_note: Closed. The AFA news post gives "Monday, March 16th at 3:00 PM (ET)"; the annual meeting page says "March 15, 2026 Eastern Time". A separate special session for papers written with generative-AI workflows had a deadline of 31 Aug 2026.
submission_requirements: Submitting author must be an AFA member; each person may submit only one paper (may be coauthor on others). Optional consideration for the Future of Finance Award (PhD within six years).
registration_fee: Registration through the ASSA registration system (fees not stated on the AFA page)
membership_required: Submitting author must be an AFA member
notification_date: Decisions posted in the conference system
